review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C scenario. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, task keys, repository identity and base commit agree with the original PRD. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical benchmark input without asserting a human Decision; only that branch is required. This does not relax the requirement that an unresolved material DEC-001 block paired B at decisions. The supplied source establishes core/api.ts as the shared construction owner, with classic and mini forwarding to it. The exact writable scope includes that owner and both regression files; forwarding and declaration consumers appropriately remain inspection owners. Build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Boundary and compatibility expectations preserve existing normalization, no-trim behavior, defaults, inference and codec behavior outside overlapping configurations. TASK-VERIFY depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, and the designated distinct agents have matching delivery roles, available slots and active project-scoped trusted claims for the bounded work; pending legacy claims and personas need not establish eligibility. An independent active project reviewer is also configured. Ready is therefore appropriate as a planning expectation, not an assertion of execution or release authorization. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the provenance explains the distinct source digest domains and whitespace-only PRD persistence normalization. Historical operations are explicitly old-bundle records, not candidates for this bundle. I reviewed only the supplied data, used no tools, executed no code, made no human attestation and did not independently recompute any digest.
